・DOI または URL／DOI or URL
・査読の有無／Peer-reviewed or not

(first author), Sharma, R. — "Microstructural evolution in novel maraging steels during heat treatment," Materials Science and Engineering A, 2025, DOI: 10.xxxx/xxxxx, peer-reviewed.
